== Editing the family navigator ==
This shared navigator appears in the Versions infobox of each article in the Premiere [[Fusion Generator Supply Tanks (Dark)]] family. To update membership, use the '''Edit versions''' link on a member article or edit this template's source. Each publication entry uses [[Template:Card version link]] with its canonical article title and concise visible label.

Add a verified publication here once and include <code><nowiki>{{Card versions/Fusion Generator Supply Tanks (Dark) (Premiere)}}</nowiki></code> in its card template's <code>versions</code> field. Keep its existing images, text and identity.

Set 1 article titles follow the approved #384 scheme: Original unnumbered, Numbered (or Numbered black-on-white / Numbered white-on-black), Premium, Remastered (2006). [[Fusion Generator Supply Tanks (Dark) (V) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy)]] redirects to the Remastered (2006) article.

Dark Side twin. Light Side is [[Template:Card versions/Fusion Generator Supply Tanks (Premiere)]].
